summary: Ingram Micro Holding Corp filed an 8-K reporting a September 8, 2026 underwriting agreement for a secondary offering of 13,125,000 shares by selling stockholder Ingram Holdco, LLC, with Goldman Sachs as underwriter and a 30-day option for up to 1,968,750 additional shares. No price per share disclosed. The company concurrently repurchased 625,000 shares under its existing $175 million program, leaving $53,007,500 capacity. Proceeds went to the selling stockholder. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch float expansion and possible further sell-downs.
